# Support

## Bugs and feature requests

File a [GitHub Issue](https://github.com/Caezarr/career-ops/issues). Include OS, Node/pnpm versions, and whether the issue is in the Tauri app, landing, or worker.

## Security vulnerabilities

Use [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/Caezarr/career-ops/security/advisories/new) — never paste CV data or secrets in public issues. See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Questions

Best-effort only; no support SLA for this personal project.
